summary: End-to-end testing of Admin 'Mark as Booked' feature (backend + frontend). All 20 pytest cases pass covering single/bulk mark-booked, delete block, admin properties enrichment, public search filter (no dates / overlapping / non-overlapping / indefinite), and 403 auth for non-admins. Frontend Playwright validated: modal open from CalendarX, indefinite checkbox disables date pickers via CSS, submit creates block with badge, CalendarCheck unblock flow with confirm toast, invalid end<=start shows validation toast and keeps modal open, dated block covering today shows badge, select-all + bulk-mark works on 12 listings, clear-selection hides bar, Cancel and X close the modal. All admin_blocks cleaned up.

backend_coverage.DELETE /api/admin/properties/blocks/{id}: PASS (200 on success, 404 on ghost id)
backend_coverage.POST /api/admin/properties/bulk-mark-boo: PASS - one block per property; created/skipped counts correct
backend_coverage.Public /api/properties NO date filter wi: PASS - property still visible (block is date-overlap only)

frontend_coverage.block-indefinite-checkbox disables date: PASS - via CSS (opacity-40 pointer-events-none on parent grid)

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py mark-booked: `indefinite: bool(block.indefinite) or end is None` — correctly records indefinite even when client omits the flag and just passes null dates. Consistent with properties.py filter which treats null as open-ended (0000..9999). Good.

properties.py date filter uses lexicographic `bs < date_to and be > date_from` comparison on ISO strings. Works for YYYY-MM-DD and full ISO timestamps but would silently misbehave if mixed formats land in the collection. Low risk.

AdminDashboard.js disables date inputs via CSS (pointer-events-none) rather than the HTML `disabled` attribute. UX is fine, but assistive-tech (screen readers, keyboard users who click the label) may still focus the inputs. Consider adding `disabled={blockIndefinite}` to both <input type=date> as well.
AdminDashboard Listings tab is 900+ lines — consider extracting the Mark-as-Booked modal + bulk bar into its own component for maintainability (exceeds the 700-line guideline).
Minor pre-existing React warning 'Received `true` for non-boolean attribute `jsx`' on AdminDashboard render — unrelated to this feature, but worth a sweep.
